name: Sandbag Walking Lunge
steps: Hoist a sandbag evenly across your upper back and shoulders, hold its ends securely, and stand tall facing an open lane.
Step forward with one foot and lower smoothly under control until your trailing knee lightly touches the floor.
Drive powerfully through your front foot to stand tall and stride your back leg directly into the next lunge.
Continue alternating legs smoothly down the lane while keeping your chest upright and core braced.
tips: Tap your back knee gently to the floor rather than banging it down under load.
Keep your torso tall and front knee tracking squarely over your toes on every stride.
